measures.name: _Custom FS Patient Retention Rate
measures.expression:
VAR __months = ABS(SELECTEDVALUE(DaysOffset[Days],3))*-1
VAR __endDate = IF (MAX ( ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] ) > TODAY (), TODAY (), MAX ( ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] ))
VAR __dateTable = DATESINPERIOD ( ServiceDateFrom[FullDate], __endDate, __months, MONTH )
VAR __futureApptBegDate = MAXX ( __dateTable, [FullDate] )+1
VAR __futureApptDateTable = DATESINPERIOD ( ServiceDateFrom[FullDate], __futureApptBegDate, 12, MONTH )
VAR __patientList =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
            Patient[PatientKey],
            "__visits",
                CALCULATE (
                    DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK ( FinancialSummary[UniqueVisitIdentifier] ),
                    __dateTable
                ),
            "__futureAppts",
                CALCULATE (
                    COUNTROWS ( Appointments ),
                    __futureApptDateTable
                )
        ),
        "__patientCount",IF(ISBLANK([__visits]),0,1),
        "__returning", IF ( [__visits] >= 2 || ([__visits] = 1 && [__futureAppts] >= 1), 1, 0 )
    )
RETURN
    // DIVIDE(SUMX(__patientList,[__returning]),SUMX(__patientList,[__patientCount]))
    __endDate

measures.name: PY Patients YTD
measures.expression:
VAR _CurrentDate = TODAY()

VAR _PYStart =
    DATE(YEAR(_CurrentDate)-1,1,1)

VAR _PYEnd =
    DATE(
        YEAR(_CurrentDate)-1,
        MONTH(_CurrentDate),
        DAY(_CurrentDate)
    )

RETURN
CALCULATE(
    DISTINCTCOUNT(FinancialSummary[PatientKey]),
    FILTER(
        ALL(ServiceDateFrom),
        ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] >= _PYStart
        &&
        ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] <= _PYEnd
    )
)

measures.name: Returned Patients YTD
measures.expression:
VAR _PYPatients =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        DISTINCT(FinancialSummary[PatientKey]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(ServiceDateFrom),
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] >= DATE(YEAR(TODAY())-1,1,1)
                &&
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] <= DATE(YEAR(TODAY())-1,MONTH(TODAY()),DAY(TODAY()))
        )
    )

VAR _CYPatients =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        DISTINCT(FinancialSummary[PatientKey]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(ServiceDateFrom),
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] >= DATE(YEAR(TODAY()),1,1)
                &&
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] <= TODAY()
        )
    )

RETURN
COUNTROWS(
    INTERSECT(
        _PYPatients,
        _CYPatients

measures.name: Patient Retention Rate PY YTD
measures.expression:
VAR _CurrentDate = TODAY()

VAR _PY2Patients =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        DISTINCT(FinancialSummary[PatientKey]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(ServiceDateFrom),
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] >= DATE(YEAR(_CurrentDate)-2,1,1)
                &&
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] <= DATE(YEAR(_CurrentDate)-2,MONTH(_CurrentDate),DAY(_CurrentDate))
        )
    )

VAR _PYPatients =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        DISTINCT(FinancialSummary[PatientKey]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(ServiceDateFrom),
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] >= DATE(YEAR(_CurrentDate)-1,1,1)
                &&
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] <= DATE(YEAR(_CurrentDate)-1,MONTH(_CurrentDate),DAY(_CurrentDate))
        )
    )

VAR _Returned =
    COUNTROWS(
        INTERSECT(
            _PY2Patients,
            _PYPatients
        )
    )

RETURN
DIVIDE(
    _Returned,
    COUNTROWS(_PY2Patients)
)

measures.name: Retention Trend CY
measures.expression:
VAR _MonthNo =
    SELECTEDVALUE(ServiceDateFrom[CalendarMonthNumber])

VAR _CurrentYear =
    YEAR(TODAY())

VAR _CYEndDate =
    IF(
        VALUE(_MonthNo) = MONTH(TODAY()),
        TODAY(),
        EOMONTH(
            DATE(_CurrentYear,VALUE(_MonthNo),1),
            0
        )
    )

VAR _PYEndDate =
    DATE(
        YEAR(_CYEndDate)-1,
        MONTH(_CYEndDate),
        DAY(_CYEndDate)
    )

VAR _PYPatients =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        DISTINCT(FinancialSummary[PatientKey]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(ServiceDateFrom),
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] >= DATE(_CurrentYear-1,1,1)
            &&
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] <= _PYEndDate
        )
    )

VAR _CYPatients =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        DISTINCT(FinancialSummary[PatientKey]),
        FILTER(
            ALL(ServiceDateFrom),
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] >= DATE(_CurrentYear,1,1)
            &&
            ServiceDateFrom[FullDate] <= _CYEndDate
        )
    )

RETURN
DIVIDE(
    COUNTROWS(INTERSECT(_PYPatients,_CYPatients)),
    COUNTROWS(_PYPatients)
)

measures.name: Practice Status
measures.expression:
VAR _Growth = [Patient Growth %]
VAR _Retention = [Patient Retention Rate YTD]

RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    _Growth > 0 && _Retention >= 0.40, "Best Practice",
    _Growth <= 0 && _Retention >= 0.40, "Stable",
    _Growth > 0 && _Retention < 0.40, "Growth Risk",
    "At Risk"
)

measures.name: Practice Status Score
measures.expression:
VAR _Growth = [Patient Growth %]
VAR _Retention = [Patient Retention Rate YTD]

RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    _Growth > 0 && _Retention >= 0.40, 4,   -- Best Practice
    _Growth <= 0 && _Retention >= 0.40, 3,  -- Stable
    _Growth > 0 && _Retention < 0.40, 2,    -- Growth Risk
    1                                       -- At Risk
)

measures.name: Custom_FS Patient Retention Rate
measures.expression:
VAR __n =
    SUMX(
        Appointments,
        IF(
            Appointments[IsROV_ActionTaken] = TRUE(),
            1,
            0
        )
    )
VAR __d =
    SUMX(
        Appointments,
        IF(
            Appointments[IsROV_ActionExpected] = TRUE(),
            1,
            0
        )
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(__n, __d)
